Name: Shaaraim
ModernLocation: Unknown; possibly Khirbet es Sira, in the lowland of Judah
Description: A town in Judah's lowland, on the road where the Philistines fled after David struck down Goliath.
BiblicalSignificance: Shaaraim lies on the flight road from the valley of Elah, where Israel pursued the Philistines.
